Introduction.zh: 苹果迫击炮向邻近三行发射有轻微眩晕效果的苹果核子弹。

Chat.en: Apple Mortar stuns three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!
Chat.zh: 苹果迫击炮让三个僵尸死死的定在原地。啪！这就是杀鸡儆猴！让别的僵尸好好看清楚我的威力！

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs stunning cores down three lanes
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向三行投射眩晕的苹果核

Introduction.en: Red Stingers fire shots at full force when close to home, and become more defensive further from it.
Introduction.zh: 红针花靠近草坪左侧时集中火力发射子弹，远离则会提升防御力，降低火力。

Chat.en: Flexibility is of key importance to Red Stinger. "I do stretching exercises every morning," he says. "It's important to stay physically and mentally nimble."
Chat.zh: 柔韧性对于红针花来说是非常重要的。“我每天早上都作拉伸练习，”他说。“这对精神与肉体时刻保持灵敏反应十分重要。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires shots at full force when close to home and becomes more defensive further from it
BriefIntroduction.zh: 离草坪左侧越远，攻击力越低，同时防御力越高

Introduction.en: Skyshooters shoot peas at attacking zombies. They can be planted in the sky.
Introduction.zh: 飞行射手以更快的速度在空中向僵尸发射豌豆。

DESCRIPTION.en: could be planted in the sky
DESCRIPTION.zh: 可种植在天空中

Chat.en: The youngest Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license. Also the only Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license.
Chat.zh: 在豌豆射手中，他是最年轻就考得飞机驾驶证的那一位，也是唯一的一位。

BriefIntroduction.en: Flying shooters that shoot peas at the enemy at a higher speed
BriefIntroduction.zh: 更快地向僵尸发射豌豆，能在空中飞行

Introduction.en: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombie takes damage it generates sun.
Introduction.zh: 阳光豆给僵尸施予阳光。当这只僵尸受伤时产生阳光。

Chat.en: As the eldest of the four bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.
Chat.zh: 作为豆子兄弟里的老大哥，阳光豆总觉得他的弟弟妹妹们不靠谱。巴豆总是很粗俗，激光豆太前卫，弹簧豆就是个懒虫。尽管如此，他依然深爱着他的家人们。

BriefIntroduction.en: Zombies that eat it drop suns when damaged
BriefIntroduction.zh: 吃了他的僵尸，会在受伤时掉落阳光

Introduction.en: Pea-nuts can shoot peanuts and block zombies.
Introduction.zh: 花生抵挡僵尸，并发射花生子弹。

Chat.en: Pea-nut knows that some folks have an aversion to him. He tries to be sensitive to their concerns and give them the space they need. Still, he can't help but miss the good old days - back when he was the most popular nut around.
Chat.zh: 花生知道有些人对他挺“过敏”。他试着了解他们的顾虑，并且给予对方足够的空间。即便如此，他仍然会情不自禁地怀念以前的时光——回到那个人人爱花生的时代。

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots peanuts and blocks zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 阻挡僵尸并发射花生

Introduction.en: Tangle Kelps are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
Introduction.zh: 缠绕水草只能种在水中，僵尸靠近时，将他们拖入水底。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, on contact
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，接触型

Chat.en: Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.
Chat.zh: 缠绕水草喜欢沉思。他主攻哲学。如果拉着他喝上一杯草根啤酒，他就开始不停地讲尼采的“查拉图斯特拉如是说”，要么就是死磕康德的“纯理性批判”，听起来的确很高大上，不过有时你只不过想聊点轻松的话题，比如水底的温度是多少。

BriefIntroduction.en: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater
BriefIntroduction.zh: 水生植物，将一名僵尸拖入水下

Introduction.en: Bowling Bulbs rolls shots that can bounce into multiple zombies. The Larger bulbs deal more damage.
Introduction.zh: 保龄泡泡滚出可以在僵尸之间来回碰撞的保龄球。保龄球越大，造成的伤害越大。

DESCRIPTION.en: larger bulbs do more damage
DESCRIPTION.zh: 越大的保龄球，造成的伤害越大

Chat.en: Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah sure. Keep dreamin, bub.
Chat.zh: 猜猜哪个队直到现在蝉联五次冠军？没错，就是保龄泡泡队。他们现在如日中天。你和你的队友以为可以有什么办法打败他们吗？呵呵，继续做梦去吧，伙计。

BriefIntroduction.en: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 滚出弹性的保龄球，对多只僵尸造成伤害

Introduction.en: Guacodiles fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.
Introduction.zh: 鳄梨向身前的僵尸发射种子子弹。被攻击时它们会冲出并啃咬碰到的僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: plant is lost on rushing attack
DESCRIPTION.zh: 冲出时即失去这株植物

DESCRIPTION.en: can be planted on water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 可以被种植在水中

Chat.en: Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he's good at what he does.
Chat.zh: 问起鳄梨自己的事情，他就会呵呵道：“我曾经被类似熊夹子的陷阱夹过。我总是能吐射出令全场植物妒忌的强力精准，岩石般坚硬的子弹。呵呵，人们说我能在水上漂。我非常喜欢墨西哥辣味卷。”没错，这家伙是有点点飘飘然不过他知道自己在做什么。

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked
BriefIntroduction.zh: 发射子弹，受到攻击时跳起并冲向前方的所有僵尸

Introduction.en: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.
Introduction.zh: 幽灵辣椒惊吓路过的僵尸，并在一段时间后爆炸。

Chat.en: You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought that it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.
Chat.zh: 光是看她你可能不知道，实际上幽灵辣椒并不是一直在哪都穿着她的那块白布。她有年万圣节穿着这件去参加万圣节晚会，当时其他人都是打扮得花里胡哨，只有她觉得打扮成一只平凡古板的小幽灵会很好玩。但这之后她彻底喜欢上了这种穿搭。对她来说，就像是找到了她的归宿一般。

BriefIntroduction.en: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time
BriefIntroduction.zh: 惊吓路过的僵尸，并在一段时间后爆炸

Introduction.en: Sweet Potatoes attract zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
Introduction.zh: 甜薯会将相邻行接近的僵尸吸引到本行。

Chat.en: Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors in the rainbow". When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.
Chat.zh: 甜薯真的和她看上去那样甜蜜。她最喜欢的动物是独角兽，最喜欢的颜色是（据她所说）“彩虹的颜色”。当她写字母“i”时，她会不自禁在那颗圆点的位置上画颗爱心。说实话，换作是别人像她那样在食物中加糖浆调味，估计会被呛坏，但是对她来说刚刚好。

BriefIntroduction.en: Attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close
BriefIntroduction.zh: 吸引相邻行靠近的僵尸

Introduction.en: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keep nearby plants warm.
Introduction.zh: 甜椒投手向僵尸投出火焰辣椒还能冰释其周围的植物。

DESCRIPTION.en: immune to frost
DESCRIPTION.zh: 不会被冻结

DESCRIPTION.en: warms nearby plants more frequently
DESCRIPTION.zh: 更快地冰释周围的植物

Chat.en: Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."
Chat.zh: 有人说，甜椒投手有点容易头脑发热。有些人觉得他火热的性格让人倒胃口。但事实是，他只是比较专注和执着而已。他爱他所做的事情。他感谢自己拥有的一切。 “我来自草坪的野草区，”辣椒投手解释。 “我努力扎根令自己立足。我是一个自力更生的辣椒，我认为任何事都不是理所当然的。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs flaming peppers at zombies and warms nearby plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向僵尸投掷燃烧的甜椒子弹，冰释身边的植物

Introduction.en: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they're planted on.
Introduction.zh: 烤马铃薯会将本格的冰块融化。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用

DESCRIPTION.en: melts an ice block
DESCRIPTION.zh: 融化一块冰块

Chat.en: How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that's how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.
Chat.zh: 烤马铃薯即使在去皮时也能活得如此积极，为什么？瑜伽，这就是答案。她从来没有错过哪怕一堂瑜伽课。此外，还有定期冥想。这是她能够面对僵尸战斗，日复一日辛勤工作而没有倒下去的唯一方法。

BriefIntroduction.en: Plant it on an ice block to melt the block
BriefIntroduction.zh: 种植在冰块上并融化这块冰块

Introduction.en: Stunions breathe a stunning cloud of gas on nearby zombies in the lane.
Introduction.zh: 眩晕洋葱向本行靠近的僵尸吐出眩晕的气体。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, activates when zombie is close
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，僵尸靠近时触发

DESCRIPTION.en: stuns nearby zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 使靠近的僵尸眩晕

Chat.en: Oh sure, everyone knows Stunion as the battle-hardened warrior with the potent breath. But he's so much more than that. He's an accomplished pianist. He speaks five languages fluently. Heck, he's the leader of a Cub Shallots group in his spare time. Dude's got layers. Go on, peel 'em back. You'll see.
Chat.zh: 哦，当然，每个人都知道眩晕洋葱作为战士以他强大的气团在战场上驰骋多年。但他可远不止这点本事。他是一个多才多艺的钢琴家。他会说五种流利的语言。哎呀，他在业余时间还是青葱年少组织的组长。这位老兄层次很多哦。来吧，一层层剥开，你就会看到。

BriefIntroduction.en: Stuns nearby zombies in the lane
BriefIntroduction.zh: 使本行靠近的僵尸眩晕

Introduction.en: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.
Introduction.zh: 黄金叶在种植时放置一枚黄金地砖。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻生效

Chat.en: "For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun," says Gold Leaf. She's a firm believer in solar markets.
Chat.zh: “即使开始投入一点点,你也能收获巨大阳光”, 黄金叶说。她是太阳能市场的死忠粉丝。

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates Gold Tile on planting
BriefIntroduction.zh: 在种植时放置一枚黄金地砖

Introduction.en: A.K.E.E.s lob projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie.
Introduction.zh: AKEE 喷射出能在僵尸之间弹跳的投掷物

Chat.en: Autonomous Katapulting Ejectomatic Emitter is actively looking for a different acronym for A.K.E.E., because let's face it, "Katapulting" is just not working.
Chat.zh: AKEE，全名为全自动（autonomous）弹射（katapulting）喷射（ejectomatic）发射器（emitter），正在寻找一组新的高级词汇首字母凑成自己的名字。因为他也很清楚自己和“弹射”毫不沾边。

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie
BriefIntroduction.zh: 喷射出能在僵尸之间弹跳的投掷物

Introduction.en: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.
Introduction.zh: 榴莲既可以防御，也能对靠近的僵尸造成伤害。

Chat.en: "When other plants talk about me, they say I'm too gruff. They say I'm difficult to approach, that I'm afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he's so much more than that. He's also short-tempered.
Chat.zh: “当其他植物提及我时，他们说我很暴躁。他们说我难以靠近，这使我很不情愿让别人离我太近。而且我的味道也很难闻。”榴莲说道。但在他内心深处，他很清楚自己不只是如此，他其实还是个很暴躁的家伙。

BriefIntroduction.en: Blocks off zombies and protects your other plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 防御的同时对靠近的僵尸造成伤害

Introduction.en: Toadstools gulp down zombies whole, then produce sun.
Introduction.zh: 金蟾菇将僵尸整只吞下，并产出阳光。

DESCRIPTION.en: vulnerable while chewing
DESCRIPTION.zh: 咀嚼时毫无攻击力

Chat.en: Toadstool just can't stand being idle. "I keep everything that I want to do on lists, and keep the lists where I can see them so that I'm always motivated!" she said. Whenever there's work to be done, she's always the first to hop to it.
Chat.zh: 金蟾菇不喜欢傻站着。“我把所有我想做的事都记在小本子上，并总把小本子放在我能看到的地方，这样我就能时刻保持动力！”她说。每当有工作需要完成，她总能第一个跳出来。

BriefIntroduction.en: Gulps down zombies whole, then produce sun
BriefIntroduction.zh: 将僵尸整只吞下，并产出阳光

Introduction.en: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.
Introduction.zh: 岩浆番石榴喷发时在原地留下一滩岩浆，可以灼烧僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, on contact
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，接触型

DESCRIPTION.en: erupts, damaging nearby zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 喷发时，对四周的僵尸造成伤害

DESCRIPTION.en: creates a burning lava pool in its tile
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在原地留下一滩岩浆

Chat.en: Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He's trying to keep it in check. He's trying so hard. But one day some zombie's going to push him too far and he can't be held responsible for the consequences.
Chat.zh: 岩浆番石榴总是皱着眉头压抑着愤怒。他一直尽可能地保持冷静，他为此付出不少努力，但当僵尸对他得寸进尺时，这只僵尸就只能为他的行为付出代价了。

BriefIntroduction.en: Erupts and leaves behind a burning lava pool
BriefIntroduction.zh: 喷发并留下一滩滚烫的岩浆

Introduction.en: Phat Beets thump out damage every second.
Introduction.zh: 魔音甜菜每秒震出音波攻击僵尸。

Chat.en: Phat Beet has been known to drop sick rhymes, dope grooves, and highly satisfactory jams, often within seconds of each other.
Chat.zh: 魔音甜菜拥有劲爆的节奏和韵律，还有令人沉迷的曲子，不过只有短短几秒。

BriefIntroduction.en: Thumps out damage every few seconds
BriefIntroduction.zh: 每隔一段时间发动音波攻击

Introduction.en: Strawburst grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage!
Introduction.zh: 爆浆草莓随着成长，提供伤害不同的爆浆莓果！

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to fire
DESCRIPTION.zh: 点击发射

Chat.en: "Big is good," says Strawburst. "Though small's pretty choice as well. And you should never discount medium. I just like sizes, really."
Chat.zh: “越大的东西越好，”爆浆草莓说道。“尽管小一点也很精致，中等大小的也不赖，我只是喜欢琳琅满目、大大小小的东西，说实话。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage
BriefIntroduction.zh: 随着成长，提供伤害不同的爆浆莓果

Introduction.en: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started.
Introduction.zh: 逆时草能让时间回溯，使僵尸回退到初始状态。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻生效

DESCRIPTION.en: rewound zombies have restored health
DESCRIPTION.zh: 被回溯的僵尸血量会回满

Chat.en: "Possibilities other to open be to need we." Warp Thyme says, "Limited too far was time to approach unidirectional the that felt always I've."
Chat.zh: “性能可的它其受接要需们我”逆时草说，“限局常非性向单的间时得觉直一我。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Sends zombies back where they started
BriefIntroduction.zh: 将僵尸回退到他们出现的位置

Introduction.en: Sea-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time, longer in water.
Introduction.zh: 海蘑菇射程短，一段时间后消失，但能在海水中存活更久。

DESCRIPTION.en: lives for a limited time
DESCRIPTION.zh: 只能存活有限的时间

DESCRIPTION.en: can be planted on water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 可种植在水中

Chat.en: Sea-shroom's celseliums have been carved with the feelings when he first met the ocean.
Chat.zh: 海蘑菇第一次见到大海时的那种感觉已经刻进了他的菌丝。

BriefIntroduction.en: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time but lives longer in water
BriefIntroduction.zh: 射程短，并且一段时间后消失，在水中能存活更久

Introduction.en: Garlics divert zombies into other lanes.
Introduction.zh: 大蒜把僵尸分散到其他行。

Chat.en: Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.
Chat.zh: 对付僵尸的好法宝，同时也饶不了周围闲逛的吸血鬼。

BriefIntroduction.en: Diverts zombies into other lanes
BriefIntroduction.zh: 把僵尸分散到其他行

Introduction.en: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.
Introduction.zh: 闪电蓝莓每隔一段时间发射一团雷云，烧毁随机的僵尸。

Chat.en: Electric Blueberry prides herself for being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when they're disintegrated."
Chat.zh: 闪电蓝莓因她的不拘一格和易怒如雷的性格而自豪。“我想让他们一直好奇着，”她说。“僵尸在被解体时总会感到吃惊：‘喔！别人都说她很弱的啊！’”

BriefIntroduction.en: Randomly electrocute zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 电击烧毁随机的僵尸

Introduction.en: Spore-shrooms fire spores that make zombies create new Spore-shrooms when defeated.
Introduction.zh: 孢子菇向僵尸发射能使僵尸被击败时产生孢子菇的子弹。

Chat.en: "My favorite arithmetic operation?" wonders Spore-shroom. "I guess I'd have to say, um, addition. Hang on, no... multiplication."
Chat.zh: “我最喜欢的算术方式？”孢子菇想。“我猜应该是，嗯，加法！等等，不……是乘法。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Spawns new Spore-shrooms from defeated zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 使僵尸被击败时能产生新的孢子菇

Introduction.en: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.
Introduction.zh: 复活萝卜将被打败的植物复活。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻生效

Chat.en: "How do I revive defeated plants?" asks Intensive Carrot. "In a word: Vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery."
Chat.zh: “猜猜我怎么让植物死而复生？”复活萝卜问道。“简言之，就是用维生素，维生素加上魔法。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Brings eaten plants back to life
BriefIntroduction.zh: 将被打败的植物复活

Introduction.en: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
Introduction.zh: 原始向日葵产出大型阳光，而不是普通的阳光。

Chat.en: Primal Sunflower is new to all this sun-giving business, so be patient with her. She's an early adopter of the all-you-can-stuff-yourself buffet style of sun production.
Chat.zh: 原始向日葵是阳光交易的新手，所以对她耐心点。她可是“想拿多少拿多少”自助阳光早期体验者之一。

BriefIntroduction.en: Gives large suns
BriefIntroduction.zh: 提供巨大的阳光

Introduction.en: Moon Beans turn into a sunbomb when eaten.
Introduction.zh: 月亮豆被吃掉后会变成太阳炸弹。

Chat.en: She and Sunflower are besties. It's just too bad their schedules make it hard for them to get together.
Chat.zh: 她和向日葵是最好的闺蜜，只是可惜她们的生物钟导致她们很难聚在一起。

BriefIntroduction.en: Turn into a sunbomb when eaten
BriefIntroduction.zh: 被吃掉后会变成太阳炸弹

Introduction.en: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles that both slows and damage zombies.
Introduction.zh: 冰龙草向毗邻的 6 格吐出能够减慢僵尸并造成伤害的冰雾。

DESCRIPTION.en: damages and chills all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it
DESCRIPTION.zh: 对身前 6 个格子内的所有僵尸造成伤害并使他们减速

Chat.en: Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
Chat.zh: 当有人提起他的堂兄火龙草时，冰龙草就会变得冷酷无情。他说：“我们对温度的看法很不一样，而且我真的不想讨论这个问题。”真是的。

BriefIntroduction.en: Breaths icy mist in an area in front of it
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向身前区域吐出冰雾

Introduction.en: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves. Hurls and regrow its leaves when powered by other Shadow plants.
Introduction.zh: 暗影龙葵是一种暗影植物，能用叶子猛烈地拍击僵尸。当其他暗影植物为其提供能量时，它的叶子会喷射并重新生长。

DESCRIPTION.en: hurls and regrows leaves when powered
DESCRIPTION.zh: 得到暗影能量时能重新长出叶片，并远程抛出

Chat.en: For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.
Chat.zh: 对暗影龙葵来说，扇耳光是一份义务，也是一种特权。他的家族有三位国王、四位大使和一位总统，他们都曾以到处扇别人耳光为荣。

BriefIntroduction.en: Smacks zombies with slappy leaves
BriefIntroduction.zh: 用叶子猛烈地拍击僵尸

Introduction.en: Dusk Lobbers are shadow plants that lob explosive buds down the lane. When powered Dusk Lobbers can lob buds down three lane.
Introduction.zh: 幽暮投手沿着本行投掷炸裂性花蕾，也属于暗影植物。得到暗影能量时会沿着三行投掷。

DESCRIPTION.en: lob buds down 3 lanes when powered
DESCRIPTION.zh: 得到暗影能量时能沿着三行投掷花蕾

Chat.en: Lobbing comes easily for Dusk Lobber, but that's only because she's had extensive training and really enjoys parabolas.
Chat.zh: 对幽暮投手来说，投掷很容易，但这只是因为她受过大量的训练，而且非常喜欢抛物线。

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs explosive buds
BriefIntroduction.zh: 投掷炸裂性花蕾

Introduction.en: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging up to 3 zombies into the dirt.
Introduction.zh: 暗樱草是一种暗影植物，她就像是陆地上的缠绕水草，最多可将 3 个僵尸拖入地下。

DESCRIPTION.en: powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring
DESCRIPTION.zh: 得到暗影能量时才能发挥拖下 3 只僵尸的能力

Chat.en: "When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
Chat.zh: “仔细想想，僵尸本就该待在地里，”暗樱草说， “所以实际上，我只是在加速这个过程罢了。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Drags zombies into the ground
BriefIntroduction.zh: 把僵尸拖入地底

Introduction.en: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
Introduction.zh: 黄金蓓蕾一次性爆射出大量阳光。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻生效

Chat.en: "Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."
Chat.zh: “你们的植物学家一心只想着能不能做到,”黄金蓓蕾说,他表示自己不针对任何人和事,“他们没有停下来思考是否有这么做的必要。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Produces a burst of sun all at once
BriefIntroduction.zh: 一次性爆射出大量阳光

Introduction.en: Blooming Hearts lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing their defences reduced.
Introduction.zh: 心蕊向僵尸投掷子弹，使之防御力下降。

Chat.en: Blooming Heart loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.
Chat.zh: 心蕊喜欢僵尸，并因此受到植物同伴的嘲笑，但她依然坚持己见。她对僵尸情有独钟，而且毫无愧疚。

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing their defences reduced
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向僵尸投掷子弹，使之防御力下降

Introduction.en: Shrinking Violets shrinks zombies in an area, forcing them to take double damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.
Introduction.zh: 畏缩紫罗兰将范围内僵尸缩小，减少他们的啃咬速度，使他们承受两倍的攻击。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, activates on contact
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，接触到僵尸时触发

DESCRIPTION.en: affects zombies in surrounding tiles
DESCRIPTION.zh: 缩小周围格子范围内的所有僵尸

DESCRIPTION.en: shrinks imps to oblivion
DESCRIPTION.zh: 使小鬼僵尸缩小至消失

Chat.en: Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how a discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.
Chat.zh: 畏缩紫罗兰一开始很害羞，但当她发现自己在减少僵尸方面的神奇才能后，她的整个观念都发生了巨大的变化。

BriefIntroduction.en: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker
BriefIntroduction.zh: 缩小僵尸，使他们变弱

Introduction.en: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.
Introduction.zh: 热辣海枣吸引相邻行的僵尸，被啃食殆尽时焚烧一整行。

DESCRIPTION.en: unleash a lane of flame when eaten
DESCRIPTION.zh: 被啃食完后燃烧整行

DESCRIPTION.en: warms nearby plants
DESCRIPTION.zh: 冰释周围的植物

Chat.en: Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.
Chat.zh: 热辣海枣很有魅力。他彬彬有礼，博览群书，有很多有趣的观点，并且善于倾听。僵尸们都要排着队等着被他烧死。

BriefIntroduction.en: Attracts and burns zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 吸引僵尸并焚烧

Introduction.en: Fire Gourds charge for a while and breathes fire ahead, damage to zombies continuously and damage more to armor racks.
Introduction.zh: 火葫芦蓄力后能朝前方吐火，造成持续火焰伤害，对付木制的兵器架特别有效。

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to fire
DESCRIPTION.zh: 点击喷火

DESCRIPTION.en: the longer he charges, the farther he breathes
DESCRIPTION.zh: 蓄力时间越长，攻击距离越远

Chat.en: Fire Gourd used to be a sidekick in an acrobatic class. But since he came to fight against zombies, he's found his unique value.
Chat.zh: 火葫芦原先只是个杂技班里的小配角, 但自从上了战场后, 他才发现自己真正的价值。

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap on the gourd to breathe fire ahead
BriefIntroduction.zh: 点击向前喷射火焰

Introduction.en: Bambooshoots dig back and forth on the ground, damaging zombies that step on them.
Introduction.zh: 竹笋在地面上来回移动，对经过的僵尸造成伤害。

Chat.en: Bambooshoot learned Earth Traversal from Tu Xingsun. After years of grinding (literally), he got his "Underground Degree" in Tunnel Engineering.
Chat.zh: 竹笋从土行孙那里习得地行术功夫, 又经过不懈努力, 终于获得“钻头工程学院”学土学位。

BriefIntroduction.en: Digs back and forth and damages zombies that step on them
BriefIntroduction.zh: 在地面上来回移动，对经过的僵尸造成伤害

Introduction.en: Snowdrops throw chilly snow balls and freezy icicles at zombies.
Introduction.zh: 雪滴花向僵尸投掷寒冷的雪球和结冰的冰锥。

DESCRIPTION.en: icicles freezes zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 冰锥使僵尸冻结

Chat.en: Zombies are always looking at her with a frozen expression.
Chat.zh: 僵尸看到她时心都凉了半截。

BriefIntroduction.en: Throw snow balls and icicles at zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向僵尸投掷雪球和冰锥

Introduction.en: Lychees damage zombies in an area around it when attacked.
Introduction.zh: 荔枝在受到伤害时对范围内的僵尸造成伤害。

DESCRIPTION.en: damages all zombies in a 3x3 area when attacked
DESCRIPTION.zh: 受到伤害时对 3x3 范围内所有僵尸造成伤害

Chat.en: Lychee knows gratitude, but bears any of his enemies a grudge. He always keep those in mind, "Tit for tat is fair play. Receive drips of water when in need, and return the kindness with a spring."
Chat.zh: 荔枝懂得感恩，当然也会记仇，心中总是默念：“人不犯我，我不犯人；滴水之恩，涌泉相报！”

BriefIntroduction.en: Hurts zombies in an area when attacked
BriefIntroduction.zh: 受伤时对范围内僵尸造成伤害

Introduction.en: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.
Introduction.zh: 香水菇魅惑当行的恐龙，使它们帮上僵尸的倒忙。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻触发

DESCRIPTION.en: affects all dinosaurs in a lane
DESCRIPTION.zh: 影响到整行的恐龙

Chat.en: Perfume-shroom emits a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
Chat.zh: 香水菇释放出一股纯净且浓缩的雾状的爱。

BriefIntroduction.en: Charms dinosaurs against zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 魅惑恐龙以僵尸为敌

Introduction.en: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.
Introduction.zh: 阳光鼠尾草感化僵尸，使他们心甘情愿地离开，并沿路产出阳光。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, activates on contact
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，接触到僵尸时触发

DESCRIPTION.en: vulnerable to critters and mechs
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在动物和机器面前十分脆弱

Chat.en: "Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.
Chat.zh: “嗡——嗡——”阳光鼠尾草低声吟诵着。但谁都骗不了，大家都知道她满脑子跑车和推土机。

BriefIntroduction.en: Illuminates zombies for sun
BriefIntroduction.zh: 感化僵尸，使之生产阳光

Introduction.en: Bamboozles can fire 5 bamboo sticks at most.
Introduction.zh: 整人竹可以发射最多 5 根竹竿。

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
DESCRIPTION.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

DESCRIPTION.en: bamboo sticks turn into bamboo buskets when hitting the floor
DESCRIPTION.zh: 竹竿在砸到地面时会变成竹篮

Chat.en: Only when confronting those skilled kongfu plants could you be defeated by a single straw.
Chat.zh: 唯有在技艺高超的武林植物面前，你才会连一根草都打不过。

BriefIntroduction.en: Click on bamboo, then a tile, to launch bamboo sticks
BriefIntroduction.zh: 点击后，选择一格发射竹竿

Introduction.en: Cantaloupe-pults heavily damages groups of zombies without smashing them.
Introduction.zh: 哈密瓜投手会以不让子弹砸到僵尸的方式对他们造成大量伤害。

DESCRIPTION.zh: 豌豆射手的1/2

DESCRIPTION.en: lobbed cantaloupes explode above zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 子弹在僵尸上空爆裂

Chat.en: As one of the most heat-relieving fruits, Cantaloupe-pult hates those who claimed him to cause "inner heat". He directs this fury towards zombies and they hardly survive from this.
Chat.zh: 作为最解暑的水果之一，哈密瓜投手痛恨那些给自己扣上“上火”帽子的家伙，他把这股怒火用到了僵尸身上，效果拔群。

BriefIntroduction.en: Heavily damages groups of zombies without smashing them
BriefIntroduction.zh: 不直接砸中，子弹在空中对成群僵尸造成大量伤害

Introduction.en: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
Introduction.zh: 冰地刺对经过的僵尸造成伤害，并使之冷冻。

DESCRIPTION.en: can't be eaten by zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 不会被僵尸啃食

DESCRIPTION.en: can take three hits from rolling zombies when fed with Plantfood
DESCRIPTION.zh: 使用叶绿素后能承受滚动前行的僵尸三次打击

Chat.en: Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
Chat.zh: 冰地刺激动地收到了顶级联赛的召唤，迫不及待地想要开始让扎穿僵尸，冻时冷藏他们。他坚持要我们用“冻时”而不是“同时”。

BriefIntroduction.en: Hurts and chills zombies that step on it
BriefIntroduction.zh: 对走过的僵尸造成伤害并使之冷冻

Introduction.en: Angel Starfruits adjust the angles and then shoot stars in 5 directions.
Introduction.zh: 天使星星果会调整角度，随后向五个方向发射星星子弹。

DESCRIPTION.en: changes shooting directions according to zombies' coordinates
DESCRIPTION.zh: 根据僵尸的位置改变发射的方向

Chat.en: Princess Angel Starfruit is far more energetic than Starfruit from a small town. Starfruit can't even be bothered to rotate himself a little.
Chat.zh: 天使星星果公主比来自乡下的星星果有活力多了，星星果甚至连转个身都不愿意。

BriefIntroduction.en: Adjusts the angle and shoots stars in 5 directions
BriefIntroduction.zh: 调整角度并向五个方向发射星星

Introduction.en: Ice Blooms freeze, chill, and damage all zombies on the board, and more so in a 3x3 area around where they're planted.
Introduction.zh: 寒冰蓓蕾冻结、减速，并伤害全屏的僵尸，尤其是 3x3 范围内的僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻生效

DESCRIPTION.en: turns several of the most dangerous zombies into ice sculptures, obstructing other zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 使场内几名较危险的僵尸变为冰雕，使之阻碍其他僵尸前进

Chat.en: "The last time Ice Bloom had pancakes for breakfast, she wasn't satisfied. She can't say why, exactly, but there was something subtly wrong with them. The shocking reason? Substandard maple syrup."
Chat.zh: “上次寒冰蓓蕾早餐吃煎饼，她不是很满意，但又说不出为什么，但是那些煎饼确实有些不对劲。结果你知道为什么？加了劣质枫糖浆。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Freezes and damages zombies, turning some of which into ice sculptures
BriefIntroduction.zh: 冰冻并伤害僵尸，将其中几名僵尸变作冰雕

Introduction.en: Zoybean Pods grow from sprouts to full pods, then split open to release helpful plant "zomboids" which attack zombies.
Introduction.zh: 豆腐尸荚生长成为硕大的豆荚，并释放一只“豆腐僵尸”为你战斗。

Chat.en: "Developing plant zomboids in eerie mimicry of zombie life is well within the boundaries of human experience," Zoybean Pod insists with a calm, unvarying steadiness.
Chat.zh: “以诡异的方式模仿僵尸生命来培育豆腐僵尸，这其实完全在人们经验的范畴之内。”豆腐尸荚坚持道，语气带着一种平静而恒定的沉稳。

BriefIntroduction.en: Grows helpful zomboids
BriefIntroduction.zh: 生成为我们战斗的豆腐僵尸

Introduction.en: Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection from cold plus an additional close range flame attack.
Introduction.zh: 柴火藤蔓可以被种植在其他植物上，使本格的植物免受寒冻，对短距离内的敌人造成灼烧伤害。

Chat.en: Pyre Vine considers his holdings, his fortune, his vast hoard of wealth. He feels it should please him, and yet nevertheless he is anxious and fearful.
Chat.zh: 柴火藤蔓审视着他的地产、财富和庞大的宝库。他觉得这些理应让自己满足，然而他依然感到焦虑和恐惧。

BriefIntroduction.en: Warms and flames
BriefIntroduction.zh: 温暖四周并喷火

Introduction.en: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last second defense when attacked.
Introduction.zh: 闪耀藤蔓能促进其依附的阳光植物的生产，使它们在生产时产出更多的阳光，月光花除外。在受到威胁的时候用阳光闪晕身边的僵尸作为防御。

DESCRIPTION.en: best used on sun producer plants
DESCRIPTION.zh: 最好种植在生产植物上

DESCRIPTION.en: doesn't amplify Moonflower sun production
DESCRIPTION.zh: 不会促进月光花的生产

Chat.en: "Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
Chat.zh: “躲猫猫！” 闪耀藤蔓咯咯笑着，直勾勾地盯着屏幕前的你。“就当这第四面墙已经碎了吧！”

BriefIntroduction.en: Increases sun production
BriefIntroduction.zh: 促进阳光的生产

Introduction.en: Atomic Bombegranates explode on contact, dealing heavy damages in a huge area and spawning Seedlings around them.
Introduction.zh: 原子石榴弹在被僵尸接触时自爆，生成小种子。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, on contact
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，接触到僵尸时触发
5x5 范围

DESCRIPTION.en: starts with Seedling
DESCRIPTION.zh: 种下时是小种子

DESCRIPTION.en: Seedlings around will grow up into new bombegranates
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在周围产生的小种子长大后会变成新的原子石榴弹

Chat.en: Remember: Never ever EVER split a fruit. Oh, hold on, actually fruits are ok, just never split an atom.
Chat.zh: 记住，永远不要，千万不要切开一个水果。哦，不对，切开水果没关系，不要切开原子就行。

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes on contact, spawning Seedlings around
BriefIntroduction.zh: 在僵尸触碰时爆炸，并在周围生成小种子

Introduction.en: Holly Knight deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
Introduction.zh: 冬青骑士对身边的僵尸造成伤害，还能发射三株带刺的障碍来击退并伤害僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
DESCRIPTION.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

DESCRIPTION.en: projectiles become prickly barriers when hitting the floor
DESCRIPTION.zh: 子弹砸中地面时生成带刺的障碍

Chat.en: Holly Knight would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
Chat.zh: 冬青骑士会告诫大伙不要吃他身上的莓果。“不提前打声招呼就吃别人身上的莓果是很无礼的，”他说。“另外，他们是剧毒的。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
BriefIntroduction.zh: 伤害身边的僵尸，点击发射障碍

Introduction.en: Aloes heal injured plants to their immediate right, keeping them healthy as possible.
Introduction.zh: 芦荟对其右边的植物进行治疗，使之尽可能保持完好。

Chat.en: Aloe likes to soothe. He likes to alleviate, he likes to restore, he likes to mend. But don't ask him to revive. He's touchy about revival.
Chat.zh: 芦荟喜欢安抚。他喜欢缓解痛苦，乐于修复创伤，擅长弥合伤痕。但别让他去复活生命——他对“复活”这个词格外敏感。

BriefIntroduction.en: Heals rightward plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 治疗右边的植物

Introduction.en: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
Introduction.zh: 超能花菜利用他们的心灵控制能力来魅惑随机的僵尸，使之以他们的同类为敌。

DESCRIPTION.en: hovers above ground or water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 能飘浮于水面上

Chat.en: Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
Chat.zh: 超能花菜压力很大，双眼晕眩地转了起来。他只是想为自己的小说写个大结局，但是他很担心自己的表弟读不懂。

BriefIntroduction.en: Hypnotizes electrocute zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 魅惑随机的僵尸

Introduction.en: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
Introduction.zh: 香果胶向僵尸喷溅口香糖，把他们定在原地，并拦住其身后的僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: stronger zombies form stronger barriers
DESCRIPTION.zh: 口香糖的强度与僵尸的强度有关

DESCRIPTION.en: best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs
DESCRIPTION.zh: 最好用于巨尸和机甲橄榄

Chat.en: "I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
Chat.zh: “我只嚼火腿口味的口香糖，” 香果胶自信地说着，“必须是火腿加盐味的。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Creates gum barriers
BriefIntroduction.zh: 制造口香糖障碍

Introduction.en: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 防御薄荷将所有僵尸击退，并为草坪上所有防御家族植物带来强化效果。

Chat.en: Reinforce-mint isn't scowling. He's just workshopping defense strategies, doing what he can to support the team. Maybe he's scowling just a little bit. Fine.
Chat.zh: 防御薄荷没有皱着眉头，他只是在反复推敲防御策略，尽其所能支援团队。好吧，也许……他确实皱了一点点眉头。行吧。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts defence plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化防御植物

Introduction.en: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.
Introduction.zh: 启明薄荷在种植时产生一沓阳光，并为启明家族植物带来额外的能量。

Chat.en: Enlighten-mint wants to stress that while "enlightenment" is properly understood as "full comprehension of a situation," she herself frequently likes to ask follow-up questions just to be sure.
Chat.zh: 启明薄荷想强调，虽然“启明”的正确理解是“对处境的完全领悟”，但她本人经常喜欢多问几个后续问题，只为图个安心。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts sun plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化阳光植物

Introduction.en: Winter-mints chill all zombies on the board when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Winter-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 寒冻薄荷在种植时使全场僵尸进入冷冻状态，并为所有寒冻家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Winter-mint has advanced degrees in cryonics and cryogenics, is a master builder of snowmen, and subscribes to season passes at three different ski resorts. He does think it's a little chilly in here, though.
Chat.zh: 寒冻薄荷拥有低温学和人体冷冻学的高级学位，是堆雪人的大师，还订阅了三家不同滑雪场的季票。不过，他确实觉得那儿有点冷飕飕的。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts cold plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化寒冻植物

Introduction.en: Spear-mints generate a column of saws from the house and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 穿刺薄荷在种植时从草坪左侧产生一列锋利的圆锯，并为所有穿刺家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: "Slash!" Spear-mint enthuses. "Slishy-slashy-slice!" she adds, wanting to make sure she's getting her point across. She wants to be very clear on this.
Chat.zh: “斩！” 穿刺薄荷激昂道。“唰唰嚓嚓——切！”她补充道，为了确保自己的意思传达到位，并且表达得极其明确。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts piercing plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化穿刺植物

Introduction.en: Appease-mints fire a volley of huge peas that break into smaller peas and provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 平射薄荷在种植时发射一打能分裂的巨型豌豆，并为所有平射家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"
Chat.zh: 平射薄荷对于自己可能在争斗中退缩的说法感到极为愤慨。“没错，我叫“平射薄荷”，但这是因为我希望大家能平稳地射出子弹，而不是不愿坚持我的信念。立刻收回你那恶毒的诽谤，否则我就写一封言辞激烈的谴责信！”

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts straight shooters
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化直射子弹的植物

Introduction.en: Enforce-mints shrink a number of zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Enforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 健壮薄荷在种植时缩小场上的好几个僵尸，并为所有健壮家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Enforce-mint shrinks zombies, which may seem a bit off-brand for a guy who's all about melee damage. Enforce-mint shrugs. "I don't set policy。" he says.
Chat.zh: 健壮薄荷能缩小僵尸，这对一个专精近战伤害的家伙来说似乎有点“人设不符”。健壮薄荷耸了耸肩。对此他表示：“规则不是我定的。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts melee plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化近战的植物

Introduction.en: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 热辣薄荷在种植时在全场燃起火焰，并为所有热辣家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Pepper-mint likes heat. He's down with flames, he digs on fire, he's a total madman for oxidization and ignition. If he sees you rubbing two sticks together, he'll come over and ask about it. He can't help himself.
Chat.zh: 热辣薄荷喜欢热，他对火焰来者不拒，对烈火情有独钟，是个不折不扣的氧化与点燃狂人。要是看见你在搓两根木棍，他准会凑过来问个究竟——他实在忍不住。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts fire plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化火焰植物

Introduction.en: Bombard-mints set off a number of explosions on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 爆裂薄荷在种植时在场上引起几发爆炸，并为所有爆裂家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: "Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."
Chat.zh: “爆炸可好玩了，” 爆裂薄荷眼中闪着淘气的光芒说。“在消灭僵尸的时候，一连串的爆破不仅能清掉大半个场子，事后还会留下美妙的香气。那闻起来就像是……胜利的味道。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts explosive plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化爆炸植物

Introduction.en: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
Introduction.zh: 暗影薄荷在种植时将场上的几只僵尸拽入地下，并为所有暗影家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.
Chat.zh: 暗影薄荷像忍者一样，悄无声息地从队伍里溜走了。“暗影薄荷去哪了？”其他植物问道。他们不知道，谁也不知道，暗影薄荷就是这般神出鬼没。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts shadow plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化暗影植物

Introduction.en: Ail-mints poison all zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Ail-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 剧毒薄荷在种植时使所有僵尸沾上毒液，并为所有剧毒家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Ail-mint is quick to state that poison should not be taken internally. Or externally, for that matter. Really, just leave it alone. It's poison!
Chat.zh: 剧毒薄荷紧急声明：毒药不可内服。同理，也不可外用。真的，碰都别碰。那可是毒药！

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts poison plants and fungi
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化毒性植物和菌类

Introduction.en: Enchant-mints randomly hypnotize a number of zombies and provide a temporary boost to all Enchant-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 魔法薄荷在种植时魅惑场上的几只僵尸，并为所有魔法家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: "I just love musical theater。" says Enchant-mint. Yeah, it doesn't have much to do with magic or his abilities or strategic strengths, but it's a fact. He just likes the songs.
Chat.zh: “我就是热爱音乐剧。” 魔法薄荷说道。没错，这和他的魔法、能力或战略优势没什么关系，但这是事实。他就是喜欢那些歌曲。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts magical plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化魔法植物

Introduction.en: Fila-mints do electric damage and provide a temporary boost to all Fila-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 电能薄荷在种植时电击全场的敌人，并为所有电能家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: Fila-mint hovers enigmatically and electrically over the lawn, surveying his surroundings. He nods, once. It is good.
Chat.zh: 电能薄荷神奇地、带电地悬浮在草坪上空，审视着四周。他点了下头，一下，情况不错。

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts electricity plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化带电植物

Introduction.en: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 滞缓薄荷在种植时眩晕全场的僵尸，并为所有滞缓家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: "Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."
Chat.zh: “放轻松，别着急，”滞缓薄荷说道。“没必要总是这么赶，行动什么的，完全被高估了。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts slowing plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化滞缓植物

Introduction.en: Arma-mints launch a volley of heavy stunning artillery projectiles and provide a temporary boost to all Arma-mint Family plants on the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 军械薄荷在种植时投射带有眩晕效果的子弹，并为所有军械家族植物带来增益效果。

Chat.en: "Lobbing projectiles, for me, has always been a very personal endeavor," says Arma-mint. "It's a great way for me to express myself, my identity, and my preference that zombies can be defeated in large groups."
Chat.zh: “对我而言，投掷子弹一直是一件非常个人化的追求，”军械薄荷说道。“这是表达自我、身份认同以及我个人偏好的绝佳方式——让僵尸成群结队地被击败。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Boosts cannon and lobbing plants
BriefIntroduction.zh: 强化炮类和投掷类植物

Introduction.en: Seashooters are amphibious and shoot in three directions while staying in water.
Introduction.zh: 海豌豆是两栖植物，在水中时可以向三个方向发射。

DESCRIPTION.en: shoots sea-peas in water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在水中时发射海洋子弹

Chat.en: While helping her niece in school, Dave accidentally left Peashooters on a Lilypad near the school's pool. Four years later, Dave returned to his niece's graduation and found it had mutated into a totally different plant. "No beach pass? No entry!" says Seashooter while personally throwing zombies out of the water. "H2-OH-NO you don't!" exclaims Seashooter to the zombies entering the lawn or the pool on its watch.
Chat.zh: 有天戴夫帮侄女处理学校的事，不小心把一群豌豆射手落在学校泳池边的荷叶上。四年后，戴夫回来参加侄女的毕业典礼，发现他已经突变成完全不同的植物。“没海滩通行证？不许进！” 海豌豆一边说，一边把僵尸从水里轰出去。“别想沾上一滴水！” 海豌豆对着胆敢在他眼皮底下闯入草坪或泳池的僵尸厉声喝道。

BriefIntroduction.en: Amphibious plant that shoots 3 peas at the enemies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向僵尸发射 3 颗豌豆，两栖

Introduction.en: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire piercing shadowy peas at zombies.
Introduction.zh: 暗影豌豆属于暗影植物，得到暗影强化时能穿透整行僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: fires piercing, slowing bolts when powered
DESCRIPTION.zh: 暗影状态下，发射穿透的、减速效果的电光

DESCRIPTION.en: hides and swallows zombies that approach
DESCRIPTION.zh: 能隐蔽自身并吞噬靠近的僵尸

Chat.en: "Phoot, " Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in the evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.
Chat.zh: “噗。”暗影豌豆说着，朝远处的僵尸射出了一枚暗影般的……呃……嗯……大概可以称之为豌豆的东西吧。“呃啊！”那僵尸显然吃了一惊，倒吸一口气。此时，暗流在这两者之间涌动。

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires piercing slowing bolts
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向僵尸发射穿透且使之减速的光束

Introduction.en: Murkadamia Nuts are defensive shadow plants who, when powered, grow jelly murk to damage attacking zombies.
Introduction.zh: 暗影夏威夷果是一种防御型暗影植物，被暗影强化时能生成胶体，对啃食他的僵尸造成伤害。

DESCRIPTION.en: damaged murk regrows over time
DESCRIPTION.zh: 受损的胶体随时间修复

Chat.en: "Some say that encasing yourself in gelatin is no way to conduct an offense, " says Murkadamia Nut with an infectious twinkle. "I say they just haven't planted ME yet!"
Chat.zh: “有人说把自己裹在明胶里根本不是进攻之道，”暗影夏威夷果眼中闪着极具感染力的光芒说道，“要我说，那是因为他们还没试试我！”

BriefIntroduction.en: Powered murk damages zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 供能时的胶体会对僵尸造成伤害

Introduction.en: Noctarines are shadow plants that explode and create clouds of damaging and slowing gas.
Introduction.zh: 暗影油桃属于暗影植物，在种植时制造能够减速并且造成伤害的毒气。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻触发

DESCRIPTION.en: Noctarine gas can power shadow plants
DESCRIPTION.zh: 油桃的毒气能使暗影植物充能

DESCRIPTION.en: powered Noctarine gas slows zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 充能的油桃能使僵尸减速

Chat.en: For a plant churning with internal gases, Noctarine's opinions are shockingly conventional. "Jaws is a good movie, " he says. Like, NO KIDDING, Noctarine!
Chat.zh: 作为一株体内翻腾着气体的植物，暗影油桃的见解却出奇地循规蹈矩。“《大白鲨》是部好电影，”他说。拜托，我认真的，我可是暗影油桃！

BriefIntroduction.en: Explodes to make gas cloud
BriefIntroduction.zh: 爆炸并产生毒雾

Introduction.en: Snap Peas dive underground, burrow towards zombies, then pop up underneath to swallow them in one gulp. Snap Peas then return to their starting spot, chew on the entire matter for a while, and finally spit the zombies' heads out at attackers.
Introduction.zh: 大嘴豌豆会钻入地下，朝僵尸掘进，然后从下方猛然冒出，一口将僵尸吞下。随后会返回并咀嚼，最后将僵尸的头颅吐向敌人。

Chat.en: "I'm a picky eater, I'll admit it," admits Snap Pea casually. "I'll eat a zombie, no problem, but there's just something about heads. I feel like they're looking at me."
Chat.zh: “我承认，我吃东西挺挑剔的，”大嘴豌豆随口承认道。“吃个僵尸没问题，但就是觉得脑袋这东西吧……总感觉它们在看着我。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Eats zombies and spits out their heads
BriefIntroduction.zh: 吃掉僵尸并吐出他们的头颅

Introduction.en: Asparajets shoot at zombies in three lanes.
Introduction.zh: 芦笋战机可以攻击前方及相邻两行的僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: must reload for a moment when finishing 7 shots
DESCRIPTION.zh: 发射 7 次后必须重新装填一会。

Chat.en: Asparagus enjoys the reputation of being the "King of Vegetables", yet Asparajet takes no pride in this. Having loved studying all kinds of firearms since childhood, he can only realize its value on the battlefield. "I just want everyone to remember the passionate me on the battlefield!" Asparagus said earnestly.
Chat.zh: 芦笋享有“蔬菜之王”的美称，然而芦笋战机却并不以此为傲。从小热爱研究各类热兵器的他只有在战场上才能实现自己的价值。“我只希望大家能够记住战场上热血的我！”芦笋战机认真地说道。

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots at zombies in three lanes
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向三行的僵尸发射子弹

Introduction.en: Spinapples block off zombies, and spin to reflect hostile projectiles.
Introduction.zh: 旋转菠萝可以阻挡僵尸前进, 并通过旋转自身反弹敌人的子弹。

DESCRIPTION.en: attracts projectiles when on being fed with Plantfood
DESCRIPTION.zh: 使用叶绿素时能吸引子弹

Chat.en: Others often question the way Spinapple deals with his problems, "Is it because of the elasticity of your body rather than your spinning that make the bullets reflected?" He replied about that, "I just like spinning, which relaxes my spinning leaves."
Chat.zh: 时常有人怀疑旋转菠萝处理问题的方式，“子弹会不会只是通过你身体的弹性反弹，而不是你的旋转呢？”对此，他表示道：“我只是喜欢旋转，这样能让我头顶的叶片放松很多。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Blocks off zombies and reflect projectiles
BriefIntroduction.zh: 抵挡僵尸并反弹子弹

Introduction.en: Ampereums fire lightning bolts at zombies and absorb electric charges from surrounding plants.
Introduction.zh: 电离红掌向僵尸发射球状闪电，并且能吸收周围植物身上的电荷。

DESCRIPTION.en: lightning bolts fired after absorbing charges deal much more damages
DESCRIPTION.zh: 吸收电荷后发射的球状电伤害更高

Chat.en: Just staying together is an ordeal for the Ampereum brothers. They must resist a powerful attraction to prevent their dangerous electrical energy from canceling out the instant they touch.
Chat.zh: 电离红掌兄弟光是待在一起都是一种历练，他们得抵抗强大的吸引力，防止身上危险的电能在碰到的一瞬间抵消殆尽。

BriefIntroduction.en: Fire lightning bolts and absorb electric charges
BriefIntroduction.zh: 发射球状电并吸收电荷

Introduction.en: Glowkengus remove fogs in a medium range.
Introduction.zh: 灯笼草驱散中等范围内的迷雾。

DESCRIPTION.en: removes fogs
DESCRIPTION.zh: 驱散迷雾

Chat.en: Glowkengi soon became inseparable friends with Torchwood and Snapdragon, dubbing themselves the "Musketeers of Flame". However, the Hawaiian-themed lounge seems hesitant to serve the trio—the owner doesn't want to see any more scorched tables.
Chat.zh: 灯笼草很快就与火炬树桩和火龙草成了形影不离的好朋友，他们自称为“火焰三剑客”。不过夏威夷风情酒廊似乎不太敢招待他们三个，老板可不愿意再看见烧焦的酒桌。

BriefIntroduction.en: Removes fogs in a medium range
BriefIntroduction.zh: 驱散中等范围内的迷雾

Introduction.en: Loquanados rotate and drag zombies towards them in a medium range.
Introduction.zh: 漩涡枇杷旋转并把范围内的僵尸向自己吸引。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻触发

Chat.en: Loquanados, who dreams of becoming a ballet dancer, has a special talent to spin in place for countless rotations. "I know I could be the greatest ballet dancer in the world, but no one wants to hire me. I just don't get it," she said dejectedly, and took a big scoop of ice-cream.
Chat.zh: 梦想成为芭蕾舞演员的漩涡枇杷有一项绝活：她可以在原地旋转很多圈。“我觉得我一定能成为这个世界上最伟大的芭蕾舞演员，但是没有人愿意聘请我，我不理解为什么会这样。”漩涡枇杷沮丧地说，顺便吞下了一大口冰激凌。

BriefIntroduction.en: Drags zombies towards her in a medium area
BriefIntroduction.zh: 将范围内的僵尸向自己吸引

Introduction.en: Pea Commandoes deploy three flying pea soldiers to launch a heavy attack on the three leftmost zombies.
Introduction.zh: 豌豆突击队派遣三只突击豌豆飞行小兵，向最靠左侧的三名僵尸发动突袭。

DESCRIPTION.en: hovers above ground or water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 能飘浮于水面上

Chat.en: were among those who failed the "Air Raid" elite selection. Rather than raiding zombie bases under the cover of night like the elites, they're better suited to guard duties at their own base!
Chat.zh: 豌豆突击队是“壮植凌云”精英选拔中落选的一批，比起那些趁夜突击僵尸基地的精英们，他们更适合在自己的基地做好守卫工作！

BriefIntroduction.en: Deploys flying pea soldiers to launch a heavy attack on the zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 派遣飞行小兵，向僵尸发动突袭

Introduction.en: Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whippings to zombies both in front and behind.
Introduction.zh: 炙热山葵挥舞火焰长鞭，抽打前后的僵尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: resist cold and warms nearby plants
DESCRIPTION.zh: 无视寒冷并温暖身边的植物

Chat.en: "The trick to proper whipping is all in the wrist," says Wasabi Whip. "Well, not the wrist, exactly, since I don't have any. You have to, like... BE the wrist."
Chat.zh: “正确甩鞭的诀窍全在手腕上，”炙热山葵说道。“呃，严格来说也不是手腕，因为我压根没有。你得……嗯……化身成为手腕本身。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Whips both ahead and behind
BriefIntroduction.zh: 抽打身前和身后的敌人

Introduction.en: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them as well as slowing them down.
Introduction.zh: 黏毒豌豆向僵尸发射毒性子弹，利用剧毒伤害僵尸，并使之减速。

Chat.en: Goo Peashooter is a goopy shooter. See? See how that works? It's a play on words. Words are often playful, folks!
Chat.zh: 黏毒豌豆是黏弹的射手。懂了吗？明白其中的妙处了吗？这有个多音字。朋友们，语言往往就是这么有趣！

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots sticky poison peas
BriefIntroduction.zh: 发射黏性毒液豌豆子弹

Introduction.en: Dark Matter Dragonfruits are shadow plants that damage zombies with dark energies. Make zombies heavier and slower when powered by other Shadow plants.
Introduction.zh: 暗物质火龙果是一种暗影植物，用暗能量伤害僵尸。当其他暗影植物为其提供能量时，能使僵尸更沉重。

DESCRIPTION.en: zombies caught in the dark energy explosion will take higher damage than those who directly contact his projectiles
DESCRIPTION.zh: 比起直接接触其子弹的僵尸，受到子弹暗能量爆炸波及的僵尸会受到更高的伤害

DESCRIPTION.en: when powered, the more healthy zombies are, the heavier they'll become
DESCRIPTION.zh: 得到暗影能量时，僵尸越健全，沉重效果越显著

DESCRIPTION.en: heavy zombies' movements become slower and will be harder to knockback
DESCRIPTION.zh: 沉重的僵尸行动会更缓慢，并且难以击退

Chat.en: Dark Matter Dragonfruit's ancestors were hunted to the depths of space. Now their descendants are back for cold, fruity vengeance.
Chat.zh: 暗物质火龙果的祖先曾被猎杀至太空深处。如今，他们的后代带着冰冷的果实复仇归来了。

BriefIntroduction.en: Launches explosive dark energies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 发射爆炸性暗能量

Introduction.en: Mirror-nuts collects energies from other nuts when they're damaged. Click to release the energies.
Introduction.zh: 镜面坚果收集其他坚果受伤时释放的能量，点击以释放这些能量。

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to shoot when charged
DESCRIPTION.zh: 充能时点击发射

DESCRIPTION.en: when charged and defeated, deals damage to all enemies in the lane
DESCRIPTION.zh: 充能并被打败后，对整行敌人造成伤害

Chat.en: Mirror-nut dressed up as a mirrorball for a disco-themed party. He never looked back, because that'd get his view blocked by his own outfit.
Chat.zh: 镜面坚果穿着一套镜面球参加迪斯科主题派对，从不回头，因为回头会被自己的行头挡住视野。

BriefIntroduction.en: Tap on the nut to fire energies collected from damaged nuts
BriefIntroduction.zh: 点击发射来自受伤坚果的能量

Introduction.en: Infernos swirl up devastating fire tornados that sweep zombies back, burning and damaging them.
Introduction.zh: 地狱火蕨卷起毁灭性的火焰龙卷风，将僵尸扫退并灼烧他们，造成持续伤害。

Chat.en: Inferno doesn't feel like he gets enough credit. "Of course I burn zombies," he fumes. "That's a given. But what about how I sweep them down the lane through the sheer force of hot air? Where's my prize for that?"
Chat.zh: 地狱火蕨觉得自己没得到足够的认可。“我当然能烧僵尸，那还用说。”他气呼呼地说，“但我用一股热浪把他们整排扫退的事迹呢？我这方面的功劳怎么没人提？”

BriefIntroduction.en: Burns and pushes zombies back
BriefIntroduction.zh: 将僵尸扫退并灼烧

Introduction.en: Sling Peas fire 5 peas in a burst, targeting the zombies closest to your house each time.
Introduction.zh: 豌豆迫击炮每次朝离房子最近的僵尸发射 5 颗豌豆。

Chat.en: Sling Pea keeps a keen eye on the whole battle space. He's alert and attentive. "If something slips through," he muses quietly, "it would be my fault. And I just couldn't forgive myself if that happened."
Chat.zh: 豌豆迫击炮对整片战场保持着敏锐的观察，他时刻警觉而专注。“如果有漏网之鱼，”他低声沉吟，“那都是我的过错。若真发生那种情况，我绝不会原谅自己。”

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires 5 peas at whole board
BriefIntroduction.zh: 向全场发射 5 颗豌豆

Introduction.en: Chilly Peppers freeze and damage an entire lane of zombies, chilling zombies in nearby lanes.
Introduction.zh: 寒冰辣椒伤害并冻住整行的僵尸，并且使相邻的僵尸减速。

DESCRIPTION.en: single use, instant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一次性使用，立刻触发

Chat.en: "Get up and freeze the day!! Chilly Pepper might look innocent and unassuming but deep down he's cold as ice. Compare him to Jalapeño and watch him EXPLODE!"
Chat.zh: “起来吧，冻住今天！寒冰辣椒外表看起来无辜又谦逊，但骨子里却冷若冰霜。拿他和火辣椒比比看，看他立马炸给你看！”

BriefIntroduction.en: Freezes and damages an entire lane of zombies
BriefIntroduction.zh: 伤害并冻住一整行的僵尸

Introduction.en: Witch Hazels use magical sorcery to transform zombies into Puff-shrooms.
Introduction.zh: 女巫金缕梅用魔法能量把僵尸变成小喷菇。

Chat.en: Witch Hazel paused, unsure how to proceed. Then all at once, she knew: Use magic, like, ALL THE TIME!
Chat.zh: 女巫金缕梅停在原地，不知道怎么继续。然而一瞬间，她悟出了：要用魔法，就像一直以来那样！

BriefIntroduction.en: Transforms zombies into Puff-shrooms
BriefIntroduction.zh: 把僵尸变成小喷菇

Introduction.en: Blastberry Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional attack in the form of lobbed projectiles that break into explosive bomblets.
Introduction.zh: 爆莓藤蔓可以被种在其他植物身上，同时发射在半空中爆裂的榴弹，并向前弹射。

Chat.en: Blastberry Vine snickers to himself. He imagines lobbing bomblets. He's been reading up on it and he knows it's gonna make a big splash when it happens. "Soon," he whispers.
Chat.zh: 爆莓藤蔓暗自窃笑，他想象着自己投掷榴弹的场景。他已经研究了一阵子，深知一旦出手必将一鸣惊人。“让子弹飞一会，”他低语道。

BriefIntroduction.en: Protects and lobs
BriefIntroduction.zh: 提供保护并投掷榴弹

Introduction.en: Turkey-pults lob tofu turkeys to the enemies.
Introduction.zh: 火鸡投手朝敌人扔出豆腐火鸡。

DESCRIPTION.en: tofu turkeys damage zombies and then charge down the lane to damage even more zombies
DESCRIPTION.zh: 豆腐火鸡会啃咬僵尸并向前冲，之后甚至能伤害到更多的僵尸

Chat.en: Turkey-pult's turkeys are so delicious, you'd never know they were actually made of tofu! Almost never. You might know. Okay, fine, cards on the table: there is absolutely no way you could ever mistake these turkeys for the real thing.
Chat.zh: 火鸡投手的火鸡非常美味，你甚至不会尝出它们是豆腐做的！永远都尝不出。也许能看出。嗯，好吧，摊牌了，你永远不会把这些火鸡和真货弄混的。

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs tofu turkeys
BriefIntroduction.zh: 扔出豆腐火鸡

Introduction.en: Stickybomb Rice lobs sticky rice bombs with timers at zombies.
Introduction.zh: 糯米投弹手向僵尸投掷糯米定时炸弹。

DESCRIPTION.en: sticky rice sticks zombies to the ground
DESCRIPTION.zh: 糯米把僵尸固定在原地

DESCRIPTION.en: exploding sticky bombs trigger other sticky bombs
DESCRIPTION.zh: 爆炸的糯米炸弹会引爆其他的糯米炸弹

Chat.en: Stickybomb Rice has extreme confidence in bombs, rice, and the abstract concept of stickiness. She's published scholarly articles about all three.
Chat.zh: 糯米投弹手在炸弹和糯米方面很有自信，以及对黏性的认识，并发表了三篇论文讨论了以上三个概念。

BriefIntroduction.en: Lobs sticky bombs
BriefIntroduction.zh: 扔出黏性炸弹

Introduction.en: Lotorpedoes supply stronger damages in water.
Introduction.zh: 鱼雷莲蓬在水中比在陆地上拥有更强的战斗力。

DESCRIPTION.en: projectiles shot on land deal splash damages above water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 陆地上发射的子弹会在水面上造成溅射伤害

DESCRIPTION.en: fires torpedos that knock back zombies in water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在水中发射能击退僵尸的鱼雷

Chat.en: Lotorpedo is a member of the Plant-Arma Club. To show off his interest, he specially shaped himself like a revolver. But as he was about to hang out, he noticed the news about the Monk Zombies were intruding on the telly. After a glance at those monks' "haircut", he suddenly felt like staying home…
Chat.zh: 鱼雷莲蓬是植物枪械爱好者俱乐部的成员，为了展现他的兴趣，他特意去做了一个左轮手枪的造型。出门前他无意中注意到电视里在播放武僧僵尸入侵的消息，看到那些武僧的头顶，他瞬间不想出门了……

BriefIntroduction.en: Fires torpedos in water, projectiles otherwise
BriefIntroduction.zh: 在水中发射鱼雷，否则发射子弹

Introduction.en: Regular Garden-variety zombie.
Introduction.zh: 普普通通的前院僵尸。

Chat.en: Basic Zombie hates the term "Basic". He doesn't consider himself some generic foe or common corpse. He's individual, darn it, and he's going to make a difference even if it kills you.
Chat.zh: 普通僵尸讨厌被称作“普通”。他不认为自己只是一个平凡的敌对者，甚至只是个随处可见的死尸。他可是很独立的，该死的，而且在你死之前他都会对局面造成影响。

Introduction.en: His traffic cone headpiece makes him twice tougher than normal zombies.
Introduction.zh: 他的交通路障使他变得比原先抗打两倍。

Chat.en: After a wild night, Conehead Zombie woke up holding a mysterious receipt for a cone and industrial strength adhesive.
Chat.zh: 经历了狂热的一晚，路障僵尸迷迷糊糊醒了过来，手里拿着一张奇怪的路障和工业强力胶的收据。

Introduction.en: His bucket hat makes him extremely resistant to damage.
Introduction.zh: 他头上的铁桶使他极其抗揍。

Chat.en: There was a time when Buckethead Zombie was hailed as a zombie genius for his innovative bucket-on-head strategy. It's been a few years, though, and zombies wonder if he's got any surprises left. His secret? He doesn't.
Chat.zh: 有段时间铁桶僵尸被当作一个天才崇拜，因为他创新出了头上戴铁桶的战略。即便过了几年，僵尸们还在想他能给大家带来什么其他惊喜。其实他一直有个秘密，那就是没有！

Introduction.en: Brickhead Zombie's brick head provides thorough brickheaded brickheadness.
Introduction.zh: 砖头僵尸的砖头让他彻底变得比砖头还要更砖头。

Chat.en: After consultation with various storybook wolves, it was determined that straw helmets and wood helmets were not up to snuff, and that brick helmets had to be seriously considered.
Chat.zh: 经过与各路童话恶狼的答辩，事实证明稻草头盔和木头盔质量根本不行，砖头盔才是最值得考虑的方案。

Introduction.en: His flag marks the arrival of a huge pile or "wave" of zombies.
Introduction.zh: 他的旗帜预示着一大批或者一大波僵尸的到来。

Chat.en: A spelling impaired zombie named "Brian", Flag Zombie keeps thinking the rest of the zombies are talking to him. At least he feels important.
Chat.zh: 他的名字叫“瑙兹”，然而他的读写太差劲了，这使得旗帜僵尸一直以为其他僵尸在叫他的名字，这至少让他觉得自己很受待见。

Introduction.en: Rally Zombie and his flag marks the arrival of a large clot or "pile" of zombies.
Introduction.zh: 大动员僵尸和他的旗帜代表着超大群僵尸的来临。

Chat.en: Rally Zombie splurged on the all-leather flag because, heck, he's worth it.
Chat.zh: 大动员僵尸花大价钱买来了这面全皮制的旗帜，因为，啧，总之这很值得。

Introduction.en: With its inflatable duck-like flotation apparatus, the Ducky Tube can quickly waddle its way through water with ease.
Introduction.zh: 套上充气的鸭子形漂浮设备，鸭子泳圈僵尸可以轻松在水中摇摆前进。

DESCRIPTION.en: increase movement while on water
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在水中移速提升

Chat.en: While many scientists argue over the origins of the Ducky Tube, few can deny its classification. Clearly it is not a duck as some would like to believe.
Chat.zh: 科学家们都在因鸭子泳圈的原形而争吵，几乎没人愿意否认它源自鸭子，很多人却坚信这一点，尽管很明显那不是。

Introduction.en: "You're not supposed to see me in the Almanac."
Introduction.zh: “你不应该能在图鉴里看到我。”

Chat.en: The zombie needs some privacy.
Chat.zh: 请给这只僵尸一点隐私。

Introduction.en: "You're not supposed to see me in the Almanac."
Introduction.zh: “你不应该能在图鉴里看到我。”

Chat.en: The zombie needs some privacy.
Chat.zh: 请给这只僵尸一点隐私。

Introduction.en: "You're not supposed to see me in the Almanac."
Introduction.zh: “你不应该能在图鉴里看到我。”

Chat.en: The zombie needs some privacy.
Chat.zh: 请给这只僵尸一点隐私。

Introduction.en: "You're not supposed to see me in the Almanac."
Introduction.zh: “你不应该能在图鉴里看到我。”

Chat.zh: 请给这只僵尸一点隐私。

Introduction.en: "You're not supposed to see me in the Almanac."
Introduction.zh: “你不应该能在图鉴里看到我。”

Chat.en: The zombie needs some privacy.
Chat.zh: 请给这只僵尸一点隐私。

Introduction.en: Is hurled onto the lawn past your defenses, then shuffles ahead.
Introduction.zh: 通常被丢到草坪中央，越过你的防线，然后再一拐一拐往前走。

Chat.en: What he lacks in reach he more than makes up for with his bad attitude, or zombattitude as he likes to call it. Don't encourage him.
Chat.zh: 他更倾向于用他的消极态度弥补了他缺失的东西，他称之为“丧度”。别惯着他比较好。

Introduction.en: Gargantuar really is kind of a big deal.
Introduction.zh: 巨尸确实不好对付。

DESCRIPTION.en: crushes plants with pole
DESCRIPTION.zh: 用电线杆摧毁植物

DESCRIPTION.en: throws imp when damaged
DESCRIPTION.zh: 受重伤时丢出小鬼

Chat.en: Gargantuar is the embodiment of power, made real. He is a juggernaut of hunger, from which there is no escape. He is fear unleashed. Well, he's fear slightly leashed.
Chat.zh: 巨尸是力量的化身，是实实在在的。他的饥饿力量势不可挡，因此别想躲过他。他会让草坪弥漫恐惧。额，好歹是稍微提升了点恐惧感吧。

Introduction.en: Phenomenally sized zombie stuffed into a tiny unliving space.
Introduction.zh: 非常大的僵尸被塞进了非常小的密闭空间。

DESCRIPTION.en: crushes plants with pole
DESCRIPTION.zh: 用电线杆摧毁植物

DESCRIPTION.en: throws imp when damaged
DESCRIPTION.zh: 受重伤时丢出小鬼

Chat.en: The ceramic confines of the Vase Gargantuar's home has done nothing to his endless hunger, his immense power, or his vast destructive potential. However, his footspeed could be better.
Chat.zh: 瓷制的囚笼并没有让瓶中巨尸丧失那无尽的饥饿、巨大的力量，以及毁灭一切的潜力。不过，他的步伐还得加把劲。

Introduction.en: Zombie Bobsled Crews will carry on even without their trusty sled.
Introduction.zh: 雪橇运动员僵尸即使丢掉了他们的雪橇也会不断前行。

Chat.en: Their bobsled might be history, but these zombies are living for the thrill of the chill!
Chat.zh: 也许他们的雪橇运动事迹已成历史，但他们可是为了霜冻的快乐而生！

Introduction.en: Zombie Bobsled Teams will take any ice trail as an excuse to slide down the lawn.
Introduction.zh: 雪橇小队会从任何延伸到草坪外的冰道滑出。

Chat.en: Meet the lean, mean bobsledding machine - the Zombie Bobsled Team! These undead athletes stick together like glue, or should we say frosty ice? They're the epitome of teamwork, never leaving a ghoul behind.
Chat.zh: 见识一下精英中的精英——雪橇小队！这些不死的运动员们如同胶水般形影不离，或许更像是霜冻一样无懈可击？他们是团队合作的榜样，从不丢下任何一个成员。

Introduction.en: The newspaper protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
Introduction.zh: 受到报纸保护的僵尸，当报纸被毁坏时将会发飙。

DESCRIPTION.en: becomes a flighty zombie once the newspaper is destroyed
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一旦报纸被毁，将会发了疯似的向前冲去

Chat.en: You can't really blame him for getting so upset; he was THIS close to finishing the crossword (23 down was "Brains").
Chat.zh: 难怪他总是不高兴，他就差一点就能完成填字游戏了（23 列是单词 “Brains”）。

Introduction.en: The heavy magazine protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
Introduction.zh: 受到厚重杂志保护的僵尸，当报纸被毁坏时将会发飙。

DESCRIPTION.en: becomes a flighty zombie once the magazine is destroyed
DESCRIPTION.zh: 一旦杂志被毁，将会发了疯似的向前冲去

Chat.en: Sunday Edition Zombie REALLY loves the comics section, which is why his rage is so all-consuming when it is torn to tatters before he's finished reading it.
Chat.zh: 周刊僵尸非常喜欢杂志里的漫画，这就是他还没看完漫画就被撕成碎片时怒不可遏的原因。

Introduction.en: Balloon carries zombies over barriers and ground defenses.
Introduction.zh: 气球使他能够跨越障碍物和地上的植物。

Chat.en: Balloon zombie has no idea where the balloon came from, but he's going with it and he's open to seeing where it takes him.
Chat.zh: 气球僵尸完全不知道自己的气球是从哪来的，但他很喜欢带着这气球，因为他也很喜欢气球带着他。

Introduction.en: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line.
Introduction.zh: 健壮有力，并且会直接冲向你的防御线。

DESCRIPTION.en: charges like a flighty zombie upon entering the lawn and destroys the first plant he meets
DESCRIPTION.zh: 蓄力飞速冲进草坪，并摧毁遇到的第一株植物

DESCRIPTION.en: slows down and becomes a stiff zombie after tackling a plant
DESCRIPTION.zh: 解决掉一株植物后减速，变得迟缓

Chat.en: All-Star Zombie is a third-round draft pick and shows a lot of promise, but come on, his salary demands are beyond ridiculous. Ten million brains per year? For FIFTY YEARS?
Chat.zh: 全明星僵尸通过了第三轮选秀，并且展现出了非凡的潜力。但是天啊，他提出的薪资简直是太夸张了。每年一千万脑子？而且持续整整 50 年？

Introduction.en: An all-too-enthusiastic imp who explodes with rah-rah-rah fervor.
Introduction.zh: 一个过于狂热的小鬼粉丝，能让内心的狂热彻底爆发出来。

Chat.en: Super-Fan Imp has season tickets, subscribes to the team newsletter, and is super pumped about exploding on contact with fans of the opposing team.
Chat.zh: 狂热粉丝小鬼买到了季票，订阅了球队资讯，与对方球迷一接触就会爆发，完全无法自控。

Introduction.en: A technological marvel from the great white north, Zomboni ices over your lawn into a barren wasteland.
Introduction.zh: 作为来自加拿大冰雪地带的科技之光，造冰车僵尸让你的前院被冰雪覆盖，变成一方废土。

DESCRIPTION.en: crushes plants
DESCRIPTION.zh: 碾压植物

DESCRIPTION.en: creates an ice trail behind it
DESCRIPTION.zh: 在身后形成冰道

Chat.en:
Introducing the Zomboni - the coolest undead on wheels! Caution: Not your typical ice resurfacer. We repeat, NOT a Zamboni® brand ice resurfacing machine!
This frozen fiend from the north will turn your lawn into a slippery slope of doom faster than you can say "brain freeze!"
Chat.zh:
这就是造冰车僵尸——最冷酷的驾驶者！注意：不是你想的那种普普通通的四轮制冰机。重复一遍，不是 Zamboni® 商标的制冰机！
这个来自北方的冰术恶魔能在你喊出“脑结冰了！”之前把你的前院变成冰封地狱！

Introduction.en: Catapult Zombie can lob basketballs over wall type plants with deadly accuracy, making it a serious threat.
Introduction.zh: 投石车僵尸跨过前方的植物，以致命的精准度向后排的植物投掷篮球，是不可小觑的威胁。

DESCRIPTION.en: crushes plants while driving down the lawn
DESCRIPTION.zh: 前进时碾压植物

DESCRIPTION.en: lobs projectiles at the last plant in the lane
DESCRIPTION.zh: 向每一行最后排的植物投掷篮球

Chat.en: Even with two ZCorp factories producing basketballs around the clock, there never seems to be enough.
Chat.zh: 即使 Z 公司的两家工厂共同参与了篮球的生产制造，这些篮球也总是被一下子卖光。

Introduction.en: "You're not supposed to see me in the Almanac."
Introduction.zh: “你不应该能在图鉴里看到我。”

Chat.en: The zombie needs some privacy.
Chat.zh: 请给这只僵尸一点隐私。

Introduction.en: Gargantuar that destroys plants that look the same in one strike.
Introduction.zh: 能一发摧毁所有相同植物的巨尸。

DESCRIPTION.en: crushes plants with supernova cane
DESCRIPTION.zh: 用超新星权杖摧毁植物

DESCRIPTION.en: destroys all the plants that are the same as those which have just been smashed
DESCRIPTION.zh: 砸击植物时，同时摧毁所有相同的植物

Chat.en: This one's got a real temper on him. When he decides to take out a Plant...it's brutal. Just brutal.
Chat.zh: 这家伙是真的非常暴脾气，只要他想解决掉一株植物……那场面，简直残暴，残暴至极。
